sage.use: secondary surface, button hover, accent panels

do: Single origin · Ethiopia · Yirgacheffe · roasted Tuesday
We bought 14 sacks. Send-it nine ways from Sunday.
Bag is up to you. Brew is up to you. Roast date is up to us.
dont: Crafted with care, brewed for you.
Thoughtfully sourced from farms we love.

anti_toolbox_hits.move: Hard non-blur drop shadow on display headlines (offset 6-14px)
anti_toolbox_hits.justification: the riso-print register requires flat-fill misregistration as its signature; the offset shadow reads as the print-bleed, not as the assistant's stencil reflex. Implemented as a 4px x-axis offset between two flat fills (Ink + Sage), no blur, no opacity. Removing the offset would remove the entire print metaphor.

off_toolbox_moves.move: Editorial-split asymmetric IA (3/5 ratio, alternating sides)
off_toolbox_moves.rationale: replaces the three-up feature card grid that is the category-conventional default; the asymmetric 3/5 ratio with side-flip on alternate sections is specific to Aurora's content shape (one feature has long body copy, the others are tag-led) and would not transfer unchanged to another brand

components.name: button-primary
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #B33951; color: #F1F7ED; font-family: 'Special Elite', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 12px 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #54494B; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: button-secondary
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #54494B; font-family: 'Special Elite', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 12px 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #54494B; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #B33951; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: pill-meta
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-block; background: #91C7B1; color: #54494B; font-family: 'Special Elite', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; }

narrative.northStar: Indie publishing meets specialty coffee. Print-feeling, name-led, asymmetric on purpose. Built for Gen Z buyers who care about the bag design as much as the bean.
narrative.overview: Aurora Coffee's redesigned visual system replaces the generic SaaS-cafe template with a Vintage Cottage Charm palette, a zine-maximalist deck (Abril Fatface display, DM Serif Display body, Special Elite meta, Homemade Apple marginalia), flat-fill riso-print misregistration on display type, and asymmetric editorial layouts.
keyCharacteristics: Sage as surface, rose as anchor, mustard as decoration
Square corners on every primary surface; pills reserved for meta tags
No box-shadows; flat-fill 4px x-axis misregistration is the elevation vocabulary
Marginalia in Homemade Apple, capped at twice per page
rules: Banned marketing adjectives (artisanal, crafted, premium, lovingly, thoughtfully, uncompromising, bespoke).
No exclamation points except in quoted outbursts.
dos: Lead with farm name, country, cup notes, roast date.
Set marginalia in Homemade Apple where a footnote would go.
Use Sage as a whole-section surface; flip to Ground on alternate sections.
donts: Use blue anywhere — even in an SVG icon.
Set body text in Special Elite — readability collapses past three lines.
Use a three-up feature card grid as the IA after the hero.
Add box-shadows; the flat-fill misregistration is the elevation language.
